max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries for requests to the server. Default is 12 (1 min). Each retry waits 5 seconds by default.

block.description: TeamCity can authenticate users via an internal database, or can integrate into your system and use external authentication sources such as Windows Domain, LDAP, or Git hosting providers. build_type.description: Type of the build configuration. Possible values: regular, composite, deployment. Default: regular.

id.description: ID of the build configuration. If not provided, it will be generated from the name.

paused.description: Whether the build configuration is paused.

project_id.description: ID of the project where the build configuration will be created.

block.description: A build configuration is a collection of settings used to start a build and group the sequence of the builds. More info [here](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/creating-and-editing-build-configurations.html)

build_configuration_id.description: ID of the build configuration to which this requirement belongs.

condition.description: The condition of the agent requirement (e.g., equals, exists, contains).

name.description: The name of the agent parameter to check.

value.description: The value to compare against (not required for all conditions like 'exists').

type.description: The type of the build feature (e.g., swabra, freeDiskSpace, xml-report-plugin).

type.description: Parameter type. Use 'password' to create a secure (hidden) parameter. Defaults to 'text' if omitted.

block.description: Parameters are name=value pairs that can be referenced throughout TeamCity. Build configuration parameters are available to the specific build configuration. More info [here](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/configuring-build-parameters.html)

artifact_rules.description: Rules for artifacts produced by the build.

build_number_counter.description: The next build number to be used.

build_number_pattern.description: The pattern for the build number.

type.description: The type of the build runner (e.g., simpleRunner, Maven2, Ant).

[TeamCity clean-up](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/teamcity-data-clean-up.html) functionality allows an automatic deletion of old and no longer necessary build data.

TeamCity allows storing presets of connections to external services. Currently only GitHub App type is supported for adding SSO to the server. More info [here](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/configuring-connections.html#GitHub)

With context parameters, it is possible to maintain a single Kotlin DSL code and use it in different projects on the same TeamCity server. Each of these projects can have own values of context parameters. More details [here](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/kotlin-dsl.html#Use+Context+Parameters+in+DSL))
TeamCity can notify users about various events using email. More info [here](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/configuring-notifications.html)

enabled.description: Enabled by default, set false if it needs to be disabled

block.description: [General TeamCity configuration](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/teamcity-configuration-and-maintenance.html#TeamCity+Configuration)

description.description: The description for the group. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

id.description: Deprecated. Use key instead, id is generated on creation and is read only.

key.description: Custom key (id) for the group. If not provided, TeamCity will generate one based on the name.

block.description: User groups help manage user accounts more efficiently via roles and notification rules. More details [here](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/creating-and-managing-user-groups.html).
Adds specified user to the group.

group_id.description: The ID or key of the group to assign the role to.

id.description: The ID of the role assignment (computed).

role_id.description: The ID of the role to assign.

scope.description: The scope of the role assignment. Use 'g' for global scope or 'p:PROJECT_ID' for project-specific scope. Defaults to global if not specified.

block.description: Manages role assignments for TeamCity groups. This resource allows you to assign roles to groups either globally or for specific projects.

projects.description: Projects assigned to the given pool. List of Project IDs.

size.description: Agents capacity for the given pool, don't add for unlimited

block.description: An Agent Pool in TeamCity is a group of agents that can be associated with projects. More info [here](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/configuring-agent-pools.html)
A project in TeamCity is a collection of build configurations. More info [here](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/project.html)

type.description: Parameter type. Use 'password' to create a secure (hidden) parameter. Defaults to 'text' if omitted.

block.description: Parameters are name=value pairs that can be referenced throughout TeamCity. Project parameters are available to any Build Configuration inside corresponding project. More info [here](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/configuring-build-parameters.html)

A role is a set of permissions that can be granted to a user in one or all projects thus controlling access to the projects and various features. More details [here](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/managing-roles-and-permissions.html#Managing+Roles)

If you need to add a password (or other secure value) to the versioned settings, you can create a token to be used in the settings instead of this password. More info [here](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/storing-project-settings-in-version-control.html#Storing+Secure+Settings)

You can upload private SSH keys into TeamCity projects. Uploaded keys can be used when configuring VCS roots, and in the SSH Agent build feature. More info [here](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/ssh-keys-management.html)

User account is a combination of username and password that allows TeamCity users to sign in to the server and use its features. More info [here](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/creating-and-managing-users.html)

id.description: The ID of the role assignment (computed).

role_id.description: The ID of the role to assign.

scope.description: The scope of the role assignment. Use 'g' for global scope or 'p:PROJECT_ID' for project-specific scope. Defaults to global if not specified.

user_id.description: The ID of the user to assign the role to. Either user_id or username must be specified.

username.description: The username of the user to assign the role to. Either user_id or username must be specified.

block.description: Manages role assignments for TeamCity users. This resource allows you to assign roles to users either globally or for specific projects.
